fields.title: GOJEP tender/award record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope. Every record carries _noticeType/_source/_scrapedAt (and _error/_errorDetail on failures). Field set differs by _noticeType: 'opened' records carry the opened-bid-details fields, 'awarded' records carry the contract-award-notice fields -- both listed below, verbatim field names/shapes from GOJEP's own listing tables.

_noticeType.title: Notice type
_noticeType.description: 'opened' (opened bid details -- open + historical tenders) or 'awarded' (contract award notices).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed extractions -- not_found (zero rows for this notice type) or blocked_or_transient (network/upstream issue).

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

resourceId.title: Resource ID
resourceId.description: GOJEP's internal id for this tender/contract. The full detail page it links to (prepareViewCfTWS.do) requires a registered-bidder login -- not fetched by this actor.

referenceNumber.title: Reference number
referenceNumber.description: opened records only. GOJEP's own tender reference number, e.g. '1360/263'.

procuringEntity.title: Procuring entity
procuringEntity.description: The government ministry/agency/entity running this tender or contract.

description.title: Description
description.description: opened records only. Free-text tender description (from the listing's info tooltip); null when GOJEP didn't publish one.

submissionDeadline.title: Submission deadline
submissionDeadline.description: opened records only. Free-text date/time as displayed by GOJEP, e.g. 'Thu Sep 03 12:00:00 EST 2026'.

procedure.title: Procedure
procedure.description: opened records only. Procurement method/procedure, e.g. 'International Competitive Bidding (ICB)', 'Direct Bidding', 'Single Source (SS)'.

status.title: Status
status.description: opened records only. e.g. 'Bid submission' (currently open), 'Evaluation', 'For archival'.

openedBidsUrl.title: Opened bids URL
openedBidsUrl.description: opened records only. Link to this tender's public bidder/supplier list page. Set includeBidders=true in input to fetch it inline into 'bidders' instead.

tenderOpeningRecord.title: Tender opening record
tenderOpeningRecord.description: opened records only. Free-text/link content GOJEP shows in this column; empty on most records observed.

awardDate.title: Award date
awardDate.description: opened records only. Free-text date the tender was awarded, when disclosed.

estimatedContractValue.title: Estimated contract value
estimatedContractValue.description: opened records only. Rarely populated on the source register.

bidders.title: Bidders
bidders.description: opened records only, present when input includeBidders=true. Each item: envelope, supplierName, bidId, financialValueJMD (often null -- sealed/undisclosed).

procurementMethod.title: Procurement method
procurementMethod.description: awarded records only. e.g. 'National Competitive Bidding (NCB)', 'Restricted Bidding (RB)'.

contractAmount.title: Contract amount
contractAmount.description: awarded records only. Free-text awarded contract amount as published (currency not always stated by GOJEP on this column).

datePublished.title: Date published
datePublished.description: awarded records only. Free-text publish date/time of the award notice.

noticePdfUrl.title: Notice PDF URL
noticePdfUrl.description: awarded records only. Direct, no-login download link to the official Contract Award Notice PDF.

listRank.title: List rank
listRank.description: Row position as returned by GOJEP for this run's result set. Observed behavior: continues incrementing across pages (1, 2, 3, ...) when an explicit sortBy is set; may restart at 1 each page under the register's own default order. Not guaranteed unique/comparable across separate runs with different filters.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across both notice types.
